summary: Evaxion A/S, a Danish clinical-stage TechBio company listed on Nasdaq (EVAX), furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026 attaching a press release disclosing that new biomarker data from its phase 2 trial of personalized cancer vaccine EVX-01 plus pembrolizumab will be presented at the SITC 2026 Annual Meeting in Phoenix, November 4-8, 2026. Content covers immune profiling showing neoantigen-specific T-cell responses and systemic immune modulation in advanced melanoma, with abstract #502 in an oral session on November 6. No transaction terms, pricing, advisors, or structural mechanics are stated; no special-situation event arises.
